command_or_fixture: Code reading of venv_bootstrap._probe_interpreter (shutil.which on the current process PATH); delivery red-team F5 and council synthesis
counterexample_or_failure_condition: Setup shell python3 matches the setup interpreter, but the agent host resolves a different python3.
expected: The notice reflects the interpreter the host will launch
known_bad_detection_method: Not executed: an inferred limitation from code reading; no divergent-PATH host was available
limitations: No host with a divergent PATH was run
observed: The notice reflects only the setup shell's PATH; the notice text says 'the python3 on this PATH' to bound the claim
proposition: Setup's interpreter-mismatch notice sees the python3 on the setup shell's PATH, which can differ from the PATH the agent host launches with (macOS GUI hosts, pyenv or asdf shims), so the notice can stay silent while the host still refuses the tool environment.

disposition_rationale: Accepted for now: detecting the host's PATH needs host-specific integration; the host's own refusal already names wf setup, and the notice states its PATH scope.
promotion_trigger: A field report of a host whose PATH differs from the setup shell hitting the refusal without the notice

counterexample_or_failure_condition: On native Windows the probe or the wf.cmd launcher behaves differently from the patched test (for example a Store alias or py launcher resolving python3).
known_bad_detection_method: Not executed on native Windows; only patched-platform tests ran
limitations: No Windows host available in this session
observed: Only patched-platform unit evidence on macOS
proposition: The interpreter-mismatch notice and the Windows remedy text (.\.wavefoundry\bin\wf.cmd setup) were verified only by tests that patch os.name; no native Windows host ran setup with two interpreters.

disposition_rationale: Accepted: the logic is platform-neutral and the remedy is selected by os.name; native evidence comes from the next Windows qualification or field report.
promotion_trigger: A native Windows run or field report where the notice is missing, wrong, or the remedy command fails
